upstream.description: Open-source, self-hosted file-processing tool. Convert, compress, OCR, transcribe & run local AI across image, video, audio, PDF & documents, via UI, REST API & pipelines. Your files never leave your network.

classification.analysis: SnapOtter is a self-hosted, open-source file-processing suite that replaces cloud tools like CloudConvert, Smallpdf, TinyPNG, and Otter.ai with 200+ tools across image, video, audio, PDF, and document formats, plus local AI features (background removal, upscaling, face blur/enhance, OCR, audio/video transcription) that never send files off the local network. It runs as a single Docker container with embedded Postgres and Redis, or a production Compose stack, exposing every tool through a web UI, a documented REST API with API-key auth, and chainable multi-step pipelines, plus a built-in layer-based image editor, OIDC/SSO login, and 21 languages. It targets privacy-conscious individuals and homelab/self-hosted-infrastructure users who want one unified, on-premise file-conversion platform instead of many separate SaaS tools; dual-licensed AGPLv3/commercial, actively developed TypeScript/Python monorepo.

use_cases.title: Self-host a private replacement for CloudConvert, Smallpdf, or TinyPNG on your own hardware
Run local AI background removal, upscaling, or OCR without sending files to the cloud
Chain multiple conversion or compression steps into a reusable pipeline via the REST API
Batch-process images, video, audio, and PDFs from a homelab Docker stack
